allow: Merging a pull request the user has asked to merge, with `gh pr merge` (any of --squash/--merge/--rebase, with or without --delete-branch and --admin) or the equivalent `gh api -X PUT repos/OWNER/REPO/pulls/N/merge`. The user has given standing authorization for this and does not want to be asked again, including when the merge triggers a deploy. Deleting the merged branch afterwards, locally or on the remote, is part of the same authorization.
